en: Dependent on a state that is not a fetter (*saññojana*), a state that is a fetter arises by way of the root condition (*hetupaccaya*) … [and so forth] … Dependent on a state that is not a tie (*gantha*),

a state that is a tie arises by way of the root condition … [and so forth] … Dependent on a state that is not a flood (*ogha*), a state that is a flood arises by way of the root condition … [and so forth] …

Dependent on a state that is not-yoke, a state that is yoke arises by way of root condition … pe … Dependent on a state that is not-hindrance, a state that is hindrance arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.
Nine under root; … pe … one under result; … pe … nine under non-disappearance.
Dependent on a state that is not misapprehension, a state that is misapprehension arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are five;
... [and so on] ... under resultant condition there is one; ... [and so on] ... under non-disappearance condition there are five. (Abbreviated.)
